title: The member event header under Frequency reads cleanly: the flyer shown whole, a kicker, a calm title, one facts list, one action row, and a countdown in the theme

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 on /events/breathe-connect-expand-2026-10-15 under Frequency: "I feel like we can do better on the event listing header and title area. Also, the countdown timers don't seem like they are a part of the theme."

detail: Under SITE_DESIGN=frequency the signed-in event page keeps the original EventDetailTemplate layout (FQ_EVENT_KIT_LAYOUT stays off) and fills its slots with kit pieces from components/frequency/members/event/event-header.tsx and event-countdown.tsx, styled in members-b.css under .fqm-evh. Top to bottom: the cover is shown whole (object-fit contain over a blurred, scaled copy of itself, the host's focus point kept, the measured shape used up to a height cap) with the mode as a glass tag; a kicker (category from events.category, then the Circle) above the title, which drops to the kit's h2 size with balanced wrapping; one facts list with icon tiles (date with the time range under it, the venue with its address and a Directions link, the host line, then the series lines and the Circle / Space / Journey links); the countdown beside the facts with no card at all (no background, border or shadow; it sits on the page with room above and below), the numbers large at the display step in the display face (tabular figures, iridescent sweep) over larger unit labels with wide gaps between units, and the live dot once doors open, with the same state machine, ticker, check-in action and door note; then one action row: the RSVP or ticket action first (a jump to the Join box, which carries id event-join under Frequency; its label follows the viewer: RSVP, Get tickets, Join waitlist, You're going, Your ticket, On the waitlist), Share, then a manager's Manage and Edit as quiet kit buttons. DetailTemplate gained an optional kicker slot and EventDetailTemplate an optional actionRow; both are absent on every other surface, so DAWN and the other event surfaces render exactly as before. lib/events/checkin-surface.ts gained countdownParts, which reads the same clock as formatCountdown.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const pg=r('app/(main)/events/[slug]/event-member-page.tsx');const h=r('components/frequency/members/event/event-header.tsx');const cd=r('components/frequency/members/event/event-countdown.tsx');const css=r('app/themes/frequency/members-b.css');const dt=r('components/templates/detail-template.tsx');const bad=[];if(!css.includes('.fqm-evh-cover-art{object-fit:contain}')||!h.includes('fqm-evh-cover-bg'))bad.push('the flyer is not shown whole over its blurred copy');if(!dt.includes('kicker?: React.ReactNode')||!pg.includes('kicker={FREQUENCY ? fqKicker'))bad.push('no kicker above the title');if(!pg.includes('actionRow={')||!h.includes('fqEventPrimaryAction')||!pg.includes('actions={\n        FREQUENCY ? undefined'))bad.push('the actions still float beside the title');if(!pg.includes('<FqEventFact icon=\"event\"')||!pg.includes('Directions'))bad.push('the facts are not one list with icons');if(!pg.includes('<FqEventCountdown')||!cd.includes('countdownParts')||!cd.includes('fq-iri-text')||!cd.includes('dot live')||!css.includes('tabular-nums')||!/\.fqm-evh-cd\{[^}]*background:none[^}]*box-shadow:none/.test(css)||/\.fqm-evh-cd\{[^}]*glass/.test(css))bad.push('the countdown is not in the Frequency idiom');if(!pg.includes('<EventCheckInSurface {...checkInGates} />'))bad.push('the DAWN countdown is gone');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-903: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
